prompts.34: Use case: stylized-concept. LM_Roosevelt architecture for a 1930 Hollywood classic early World of Warcraft MMO. One isolated full-building THREE QUARTER concept showing street front, right side and roof, plain neutral warm grey background. Historic Hollywood Roosevelt Spanish Colonial Revival character, adapted to a WIDE 74m frontage x58m depth x24m tall rectangular collision mass: SEVEN readable floors total, one 4.5m ground arcade and six compact 3m upper floors. Cream ivory stucco, repeated dark square sash windows with bold cream sills, grouped arched windows with thin columnettes only at topmost floor and a few central upper bays, dark wrought iron balcony bands. Ground frontage: broad shaded arched arcade, central inviting taller dark arch with warm amber doorway, discreet green/oxblood accents. Red terracotta shallow pent-roof edges and low flat tar roof within, restrained Spanish baroque relief near central entry. Blank narrow rooftop sign backing with exposed dark iron supports, no letters. Main envelope fills rectangular box on all sides, no tall tower or deep courtyard cutouts. Roof/back are finished. Chunky readable silhouettes, hand-painted warm top highlights and cool lower AO, restrained brush texture. No people, cars, signs/text, logos, modern post1930 details, palm trees, surrounding street or sky.
